title: Emmy Noether: Modern LaTeX Working Corpus and Multilingual Translation Drafts (R823 Source Control and Spanish Working Reader)
description:
This is the reader-facing Emmy Noether working record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. The record continues to front 00_Noether_German_Cumulative_Working_SourceControl_v26_R823_20260717.pdf, a 466-page German source-control working reader.

Spanish R823 reader: 02a_Noether_Spanish_R823_Cumulative_WorkingTranslation_20260718.pdf is a 473-page cumulative Spanish working translation aligned to the R823 German corpus. It covers 81/81 declared source units, Papers 1-43, all 31 lecture-book sections, and the retained post-book and terminal material. File 10 groups the editable TeX, exact German authority TeX, terminology and provenance records, source/target manifests, unit-parity ledger, completion gate, build recorder/log, artifact hashes, and visual-QA evidence.

The local v3 production gate reports every check passed. Before publication, the archive pass independently verified 13/13 frozen artifact hashes, found no fatal, undefined, box-overflow, or missing-character matches in the final log, confirmed PDF text extraction, and visually inspected beginning, middle, terminal, and dense-math renders.

Other current material: file 09 retains twelve bounded R823-synchronized English components, CJK/Korean Papers 26 and 36, and the Slavic lecture-book title/introduction. File 08 retains the Paper 06 Slavic tranche. The full RA10 English reader and other inherited multilingual readers remain working branches that are not globally synchronized to R823.

Status caveat: this is a substantial source-reconciled Spanish working translation inside a serious source-repair and multilingual corpus. It is not a critical edition, native-language or peer-review certificate, publication-grade final edition, author-wide or paper-by-paper source-faithfulness certificate, or guarantee that every mathematical symbol has received independent human verification.

GitHub: corrections, source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, and translation improvements can be suggested through issues or pull requests at https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Reader-first public surface with the R823 German source-control head, a 473-page Spanish source-reconciled working translation, twelve bounded R823 English components, and bounded CJK/Korean and Slavic units. Not a critical edition, native-language certification, peer review, or complete synchronization of every language branch.
